Un AppImage por juego (Red Alert, Tiberi: One AppImage per game (Red Alert, Tiberian Dawn and Dune 2000): all three are installed and each appears in the library. The original content is downloaded from the game itself.
El paquete es un constructor, no un jueg: The package is a builder, not a portable game. It requires the files extracted from Xbox and a Linux build environment with LLVM, Rust, Mono and the Windows SDK. Deck Library does not automate that environment yet; BLACK XBERecomp or Black Definitive HD are better for the integrated Proton installation.
Constructor nativo para Linux/Steam Deck: Native builder for Linux/Steam Deck (test version). Choose a folder with Bayonetta 2 v1.2's exefs and romfs. Encrypted NSP/XCI files are not accepted. The assistant validates the files and builds the game; afterwards it offers Play.
Windows con Proton. Colocar la ISO o los: Windows with Proton. Place the ISO or the extracted BLACK files (Xbox, USA or Europe) in assets. The first start builds the game; it does not include the original data.
Windows con Proton. Requiere los archivo: Windows with Proton. Requires the original BLACK files; see the project's README to prepare the game folder.
Windows de 32 bits con Proton. Requiere: 32-bit Windows with Proton. Requires game/default.xbe (Xbox NTSC-U or compatible PAL), next to the port folder. Saves are in port/savedata.
Proyecto experimental sin paquete public: Experimental project with no published package. Requires building from source and an extracted PS4 copy. The project still reports startup limitations; it is not offered as a game ready to install.
El asistente de Athelas permite elegir u: Athelas's assistant lets you choose an ISO or the extracted Xbox files for The Two Towers and Return of the King. The PC game uses its installed folder.
Elegir el CUE/BIN NTSC-U. Se copia el BI: Choose the NTSC-U CUE/BIN. The MODE2/2352 BIN is copied to assets/ctr-u.bin; a 2048-byte-per-sector ISO does not work.
El asistente del port pide la carpeta de: The port's assistant asks for the extracted PS4 game folder. It does not use a PS3 ISO.
El asistente pide la carpeta extraída de: The assistant asks for the extracted inFAMOUS Second Son folder from PS4 CUSA00223, with update 1.07 integrated.
El importador del port prepara los archi: The port's importer prepares the Sonic Unleashed files from Xbox 360. The Windows package with Proton is offered when the only Linux package is a Flatpak.
El asistente del port pide la imagen del: The port's assistant asks for the Super Smash Bros. Melee GameCube disc image.
El asistente del port pide la ROM compat: The port's assistant asks for a compatible Nintendo 64 Super Smash Bros. ROM.
El asistente de Crash acepta un disco CH: Crash's assistant accepts a CHD disc or a CUE with its BIN.
El asistente del kit pide el disco y la: The kit's assistant asks for a compatible disc and BIOS; it generates and builds the game on first start, inside the KDE SDK.
Su lanzador pide la ISO/XISO USA de Xbox: Its launcher asks for the USA Xbox ISO/XISO on first start. On Linux it uses the zenity picker if installed and, otherwise, a terminal with twotowers-setup.
La versión publicada contiene una herram: The release contains a build tool, not a ready portable game. The full process uses the project's installer and the Super Smash Bros. Ultimate files.
Time Crisis asks for timecris.zip from MAME 0.271 or later. The AppImage looks for the ZIP next to the executable, in its roms folder or in Downloads.

Kit de instalación: requiere el disco y: Setup kit: requires your own disc and BIOS and builds the game on first start. On the Deck it runs inside Flatpak's KDE SDK, which the app installs once (no root).
Descarga de openpete.com (se verifica el: Download from openpete.com (the published SHA-256 is verified). Needs the NTSC-U disc SCUS-94228. It builds the game from the disc on first start, inside Flatpak's KDE SDK.
Descarga de ctr.cmzi.uk (el sitio no pub: Download from ctr.cmzi.uk (the site publishes no hash; the size is checked). Needs the raw MODE2/2352 BIN of the NTSC-U disc SCUS-94426, which is copied as ctr-u.bin to ~/.local/share/ctr-turbocharged.
Instala el AppImage de Time Crisis. Usa: Installs the Time Crisis AppImage. Uses timecris.zip from MAME 0.271 or later.
Instala o actualiza con el instalador y: Installs or updates with the official installer and data. Requires your own Xbox 360 copy. The PS3 version is not supported.
Project Picori, port nativo. Necesita la: Project Picori, native port. Needs the GBA ROM (recognized by SHA-1, whatever the file name); the European edition includes the Spanish text.
Reimplementación nativa en C (snesrev/ze: Native C reimplementation (snesrev/zelda3). It is built on the Deck inside the KDE SDK and needs the USA ROM: it is accepted with or without the 512-byte header. There is no official Spanish version.
Port nativo por recompilación. Necesita: Native port by recompilation. Needs the Wii U disc (.wux/.wud/.wua) and, for .wux/.wud, the disc key and the common key, which are read from EmuDeck's keys.txt and used only in temporary files. The USA version includes Spanish.
Necesita el disco SLUS-00875 (EE. UU.) y: Needs the disc SLUS-00875 (USA) and the BIOS SCPH-5502 or 5552 (Europe).
Necesita el disco SLUS-01378 (EE. UU., R: Needs the disc SLUS-01378 (USA, Rev 1) and the BIOS SCPH-1001 (USA). A European copy does not work.
